opening.argument: The presentation solicits money for entry into a OneCoin project by directing viewers to transfer funds through a bank or Perfect Money in exchange for tokens. It then illustrates a €1,000 project and promotes returns exceeding twice the capital within a few months, alongside a stated three-to-seven-times increase over thirteen months. Additional paid packages, including €500 and €5,000 options, and a registration link reinforce the solicitation. These are projected appreciation and withdrawal calculations tied to token purchase, while the linked destination, calculations, liquidity, and any completed payment or payout remain unverified.
